title: Ambiguity Detector
description: Enumerate all parse trees for a string to prove ambiguity by finding multiple trees for the same input.

steps.description: Reveal AMBIGUOUS grammar: E -> E + E | id, the naive ambiguous grammar.
Reveal gen_trees: recursively generates all trees up to max_depth.
Reveal leaves: extracts terminal symbols in left-to-right order.
Reveal trees_for: finds all trees matching a target leaf sequence.

steps.question: How many trees does the naive grammar produce for a + b + c?

steps.description: Reveal main: compares naive and layered grammars on the same input.
Reveal explanation: ambiguity matters because different trees give different results with non-associative operators.
Run to show naive grammar trees.
Run to show layered grammar produces only one tree.
